notes.title: The Signifier: Director's Cut Patch 1.101
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37118519/34550a1f427e82a0c0b19f5c11434bbdcf3e4506.png[/img]

Patch DC 1.101 Notes:

- Stuttering: Greatly reduced stuttering in high fps/high refresh rate setups.
- Remapping: Now you can remap to the numpad.
- Fixed a bug that would make the subtitles when inspecting objects overlap with previous subtitles.
- Fixed pressing Button for objectives not working on some controllers
- New Game / Load: Fixed a bug that could prevent you from starting a new game while the game was already running.
- UI: Arrows for selecting slots with a mouse are more responsive.
- Localization German: In the Dream scene, there was some German lines that were cut off (fixed, thanks Marko!)
- Dream scene: Boiler area had too many overlapping sounds, better mixing.
- Recall Raw Data: Fixed a bug that would prevent you from using recall raw data in the club.
- Minor usability tips in final memory.
- Better sound mixing in some scenes where the dialogue was too low.
- A lot of typo fixes. 
- Fixed some of the eye icons not becoming dark when you already listened to the available text.
- Bigger hitboxes in some areas.


We'll keep working on better support for other controllers (besides xbox and ps), and keep an eye on the forums for any issues you may have :). Thanks for all the feedback!

notes.title: Inside the Director’s Cut Update
notes.content:
Launching our first game brought an unbelievable feeling to everyone at Playmesudio. When we saw players connect with The Signifier and read the positive reviews, that made all the work that went into the game so worth it. In an instant we felt more than just relief; we felt energized. We knew we wanted to reach the full vision we saw so close in reach.

We decided to go for it and create a Director’s Cut that goes as extra level in everything to deliver on our research and preproduction. And we made it a free update so everyone, those who played and loved the Signifier and those for whom this will be their first time playing it, get the ultimate experience.

With the update set to release Thursday 22 April, it's time to share some details!
[h2]STORY[/h2]
A lot of the work went into better developing connections in the second half of the game. With multiple layers and complex characters, the big picture of The Signifier seemed to overshadow little things we wanted players to get. New dialog, lore items like personal notes, emails, and articles, and a full epilogue bring out great subtleties. Players will learn much more about each of the characters and the experiences that happened in each location. Important choices that shape the outcome are highlighted to be better recognized. And their results come through stronger than ever with three new endings in addition to the original three.
[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
Next, we set out to make it as easy as possible for players to experience the full story of The Signifier. That work started with making objectives clearer, and then providing additional feedback in places where the way forward was not always apparent. Even so, for players wanting a cinematic experience we added a new easy mode. In it, players get direct guidance on what to do next from the EVEE artificial intelligence in the game. This mode can also be switched to and from at will to get a little help when you want it and not when you do not. Other little improvements like controller mapping, improving the feel of interactions, and adding more save slots add a little extra polish.
[h2]PERFORMANCE & VISUALS[/h2]
To complete the package, we went through the code to find every optimization possible to benefit machines of every spec. We were able to greatly reduce memory usage and improve framerate throughout. The result has the game feeling responsive overall. Playing at 4k on a mid-range PC is totally doable, and high-end PC's will get over 60fps. Topping it all off, completely revamped character animations make immersion in the game world that much more complete.

[h3]Enjoy the ultimate expression of The Signifier[/h3]
Whether you’re coming back, or this will be the first time, we hope each playthrough of The Signifier with the Director’s Cut update brings you enjoyment and leads to exploring new questions.

[i]-The Playmestudio Team[/i]

notes.title: New Patch!
notes.content:
Hello! A new patch is live, fixing the issues that were happening in only a few setups, plus some optimizations. Big thanks to all the feedback and to the people that shared their logs and time to test with us :). Hope you enjoy the journey!

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed controller issues in some setups. Important: If you use Steam Input for PS4 or XBOX controllers in global steam settings (off by default), you need to turn it off for The Signifier in the game's properties ( "Steam Input Per-Game Setting").
[*] Fixed possible crash when changing location the game in a few setups.
[*] Fixed rare bug that would prevent some users to Load a savegame.
[*] Fixed a bug that would keep Raw Data available even after it was solved in a few setups.
[*] Fixed some saves that would save at the beggining of a location but would make you appear at the end of the last one, confusing the player.
[*] Fixed an issue that would prevent getting the achievement "A different person".
[*] Fixed an issue that would make the game load forever when entering the machine for the first time in some setups (codec issue).
[*] Fixed an issue that would prevent players from changing states with Q.
[*] Hitbox for videologs in warehouse bigger for visibility.
[*] Fixed a rare bug in which the player was not able to retain control after talking with Stan.
[*] Fixed an issue that would make the text "new" to never go away in the event 2 of the club, confusing the player.
[*] Other minor optimizations and typo fixes.
[/list]
